supersedes_for_next_review.reason: v11 correctly identified lost inner gh-api observability but proposed changing canonical admin-channel support before first isolating the exact transport cause. v12 narrows the next live-capable candidate to a standalone nonmutating probe with no production-code semantic change.

observed_problem.causal_limit: Canonical PhaseCAdminChannel._read_fixed discards the gh subprocess return code and stderr before mapping empty stdout to PHASE_C_GITHUB_API_NO_RESPONSE, so the current receipt cannot distinguish auth/login, DNS, connectivity/timeout, TLS/certificate, HTTP/API, CLI/config, or another nonempty stderr class.
observed_problem.not_proven: The evidence does not prove that GitHub itself returned no response.

probe_contract.network_call: exactly one gh api GET /user using the same hostname/include/Accept/API-version/method command shape as canonical PhaseCAdminChannel._read_fixed user endpoint
